_attribution: Adapted from affaan-m/ECC (MIT), commit d3b8a3e. Merged for Neva.
_about: Module registry for dispatch.py. events: hook events the module listens on (every event is one * matcher in hooks.json). tools: optional fnmatch list of tool names; the module runs only for those tools. profiles: which NEVA_HOOK_PROFILE values run it. Order inside an event is run order. Disable any id with NEVA_DISABLED_HOOKS. The human-readable table is docs/harness/hooks.md.

modules.description: Inject strong instincts (canonical project/<id> and global folders), today's journal head, inbox open actions, open instinct proposals and the last session summary for this worktree or repo (8000 char cap); prune session files older than 30 days.
ck skill: record current-session.json and inject the project's saved goal, where it left off and next steps (or the 3 most recent ck projects). No-op when ck data does not exist.
Once per session: GOALS.md and project states when a prompt is about direction; the matching project note when the working directory is under its code path.
hookify rules with event prompt or all: warn with context or block the prompt.
Block git hook bypasses: --no-verify (and prefixes), commit -n clusters, -c core.hooksPath, git config core.hooksPath, HUSKY=0.
safety-guard careful mode (on while <NEVA_STATE_DIR>/safety-guard/careful exists): ask before destructive commands.
On git commit: block secret shapes and debugger statements in the staged diff; warn on console.log, possible hardcoded secrets and non-conventional messages.
On git push: remind to check what will be published; flag shared branches and force pushes.
Dev server started in the foreground outside tmux: warn (standard) or block (strict), with the exact tmux command. run_in_background is allowed.
Writes into the vault outside NEVA_VAULT_WRITABLE folders ask the user first.
safety-guard freeze mode (on while <NEVA_STATE_DIR>/safety-guard/freeze-dir.txt names a directory): deny edits outside it.
Block edits that loosen lint, format or type configs: rules turned off or to warn, strict flags off, new ignores or excludes, removed rules, lowered levels.
Warn on ad-hoc NOTES/TODO/SCRATCH style files outside structured doc folders.

GateGuard first-edit gate: deny the first Edit, Write or MultiEdit of each file until the model lists importers or callers, affected API, data shapes and the user's instruction verbatim; the retry passes.
strategic-compact nudge: context size from the transcript (160k of a 200k window, 800k of a 1M window, then every 60k more); edit-count fallback at 50 then every 25 when no usage is recorded yet.
hookify rules from .claude/hookify.*.local.md with event bash, file or all: warn with context or block the call.
Mark an MCP server unhealthy after a transport, auth, rate-limit or availability failure and block calls to it until its backoff passes. Runs for mcp__* tools only.

continuous-learning-v2 observation hook: append scrubbed, truncated tool events (with `path` on tool_start) to <observations dir>/<project-id>/observations.jsonl for the nightly instinct analyzer. NEVA_SKIP_OBSERVE=1 skips.
Remember files edited this response for the Stop format and typecheck pass.
Write the summary block into the session file and one line into today's journal log before compaction.
plan-canvas: block the stop while canvas feedback is queued with no listener, and hand over up to 20 items. Allows on any error.
Refresh the per-session summary between NEVA:SUMMARY markers in the session file.
Append a cumulative cost snapshot to <NEVA_METRICS_DIR>/costs.jsonl (default ~/.local/share/neva/metrics) when transcript usage changed.
Once per response, format edited files with the project's own biome, prettier, pint or ruff; strict also runs tsc and feeds errors back once.
hookify rules with event stop or all: warn, or refuse the stop once (never twice in a row).
delivery-gate: block on critical disk space or on a complex task without learning capture; warn on rationalization phrases.
Once per session, block the stop when 5 or more tool calls ran and nothing was written to the journal.
Optional macOS notification when a response is ready. Off unless NEVA_NOTIFY=1.
One audit line per session id in today's journal log, updated in place on resume.

continuous-learning-v2 same-day trigger, off unless NEVA_INSTINCT_SAMEDAY=1 (it makes model calls): fire instinct-analyze.py in the background once NEVA_INSTINCT_SAMEDAY_MIN (default 200) observations are pending in buckets the analyzer would analyze (each at or above its own minimum) and NEVA_INSTINCT_SAMEDAY_HOURS (default 6) have passed since the analyze lock last moved. No-op under NEVA_HEADLESS; blocked by the same lock instinct-analyze.py takes at startup.
